arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Calendar year 2016 monthly values for OCS rents and royalties from the bulletins
# From 2016_12 bulletin (Jan-Sept 2016) and 2017_06 bulletin (Oct-Dec 2016)
cy2016_values = [
    56,     # Jan 2016
    -353,   # Feb 2016
    -152,   # Mar 2016
    -100,   # Apr 2016
    -347,   # May 2016
    -339,   # June 2016
    -97,    # July 2016
    -413,   # Aug 2016
    -338,   # Sept 2016
    -61,    # Oct 2016 (from 2017_06 bulletin)
    -297,   # Nov 2016 (from 2017_06 bulletin)
    -94     # Dec 2016 (from 2017_06 bulletin)
]

print('Calendar Year 2016 OCS Rents and Royalties:')
for i, v in enumerate(cy2016_values):
    month_name = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'][i]
    print(f'{month_name}: {v} (abs={abs(v)})')

abs_values = [abs(v) for v in cy2016_values]
min_abs = min(abs_values)
min_idx = abs_values.index(min_abs)
month_name = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'][min_idx]
print(f'\\nLowest absolute value: {min_abs} (from {month_name} 2016, raw value: {cy2016_values[min_idx]})')
print(f'Answer (absolute value): {min_abs}')
"
